title: Cover requested claim and canonical run drift in same-binding maintenance opening classification
outcome: Existing request-boundary regression coverage distinguishes a genuine requested-claim or canonical-run/run-generation mismatch from a qualified same-binding unpublished maintenance transition, preserving final409 versus retryable503 semantics.
acceptance: Request-level negative controls using the existing fixture reject requested-claim and canonical active-run/run-generation mismatches with the existing409 while the captured same-binding InFlight predicate itself remains true; the existing valid same-binding503 control remains intact.
